SELECT PA.PA_MONTH_STR, PA.ATT_MO_FLAG, PA.ATT_APPLY_LOCK_FLAG, PA.ATT_MO_LOCK_FLAG, PA.PA_APPLY_LOCK_FLAG, PA.PA_LOCK_FLAG, PA.LOCK_USER_ID, TO_CHAR(PA.LOCK_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') LOCK_DATE, PA.PA_OPEN_FLAG, PA.CPNY_ID, TO_CHAR(PA.PA_OPEN_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') PA_OPEN_DATE, PA.ACTIVITY, PA.STAT_NO, S1.CONTENT STAT_NAME, GET_DEPT_NAME(PA.AR_DEPT_NO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) AR_DEPT_NAME, PA.AR_DEPT_NO FROM PA_PROGRESS PA, SY_GLOBAL_NAME S1 WHERE 1 = 1 AND PA.STAT_NO = S1.NO(+) AND S1.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR#
PA.PA_MONTH_STR = #arMonth#

PA.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR#

ORDER BY PA.PA_MONTH_STR DESC
